Your #coastal-team thread from 17 Feb settles it: the lamp delivery at door 6 was on the retail account, not the container pickup. The "PHL" code is shared by both accounts, which is why you and Kwame kept going round on it. The account profile now says to check the dropdown when filing tickets.
